description: This file defines a service class `GeminiService` that wraps communication with Google's Gemini Generative AI API. It handles API key configuration, client initialization, and provides methods to generate AI responses based on conversation history, making it a core component for interacting with the external Gemini API in the application.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: Service class for interacting with Google's Gemini API, handling API configuration and chat response generation.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiService by loading the API key from environment variables and configuring the Gemini API client.

methods.name: str generate_reply( self, history: List[Dict[str, str]], user_message: str )
methods.description: Generates an AI reply based on conversation history and a new user message by interacting with the Gemini API.

methods.name: bool is_configured(self)
methods.description: Checks if the GeminiService is properly configured with an API key.
